source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("transit app" OR "journey planner" OR "real-time information" OR "smart card") AND (transit OR "public transport")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("transit app" OR "journey planner" OR "real-time information" OR "smart card") AND (transit OR "public transport"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("journey planner" OR "real-time information" OR "smart card" OR "transit app") AND ("public transport" OR "transit"))
